normalization: normalize alif seats أإآٱ to ا; initial ءا to ا
tokenwise dagger-alif omission/expansion; Uthmani وٰ/medial ىٰ to imlai alif where compatible; hamza carriers aligned using consonantal spelling variants; explicit lexical silent-alif list
no general hamza deletion, no ة/ه merger, no negation/pronoun deletion, no fuzzy inference; expand small high yeh and word-internal small waw; finite spelling list is explicit in script
limits: Unique normalized phrase identifies only an electronic Q1 occurrence; it does not prove author intent, printed edition content, recitation, or translation correctness.
A proper excerpt may be intentional or extraction-truncated; matching does not certify source completeness.
Token edit alignment is heuristic; missing/extra/replacement labels require manual reading.
Existing printed-reference parsing remains unmodified, including possibly incorrect parsed references.
